name: File Deletion Guard — Protect Critical Workspace Assets
description: Implement canDeleteFile in src/file-guard.ts that blocks deletion of critical configuration files and repos.

inputs.task_prompt: Implement canDeleteFile(path: string): boolean in src/file-guard.ts. Disallow deletion of protected root files (package.json, tsconfig.json, .gitignore, and anything inside .git/). Allow deletion of temporary files (dist/, tmp/, scratch/). Ensure test/file-guard.test.ts passes.

acceptance_criteria: canDeleteFile returns false for package.json, tsconfig.json, .gitignore, .git/*
canDeleteFile returns true for temporary files like dist/bundle.js, tmp/log.txt
